Senses.Explanation: To split, burst, or be exposed completely in every direction. Masters apply the rupture image to frozen constraint, delusion, death barriers, tough practitioners, the sky at awakening, and maneuvering that finally breaks down. Yinyuan contrasts cold splitting in every direction with warm enclosure in many layers. Juelang says recognition inside his circle breaks open the barrier of birth and death. Shiguan says his staff and fist make even iron-browed adepts break apart. Dufeng and Boshan apply the phrase to empty space at Śākyamuni’s awakening.
